issue.title: Clippy needless_return in task_theme.rs blocks just check on d712168f
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `cargo clippy -p bob-obsidian --lib (needless_return in src/native/capture/task_theme.rs:706,709,735,748,758,760)`

`just check` fails on clean d712168f (fe.2 merge landing) with 6 deny `clippy::needless_return` errors in `src/native/capture/task_theme.rs` (lines 706,709,735,748,758,760, e.g. `return Ok(None)`). `cargo clippy -p bob-obsidian --lib` on stashed clean tree reports 6 occurrences; with fb.2.1 repairs applied the count is identical. Not caused by fb.2.1 repairs (that tree touches output.rs, pomodoro_close.rs, successors.rs, scan.rs, keep_moving tests, docs, not task_theme.rs). Fix is to remove the `return` per clippy suggestion.

Repro: `git stash push --include-untracked`, `cargo clippy -p bob-obsidian --lib 2>&1 | grep -c "unneeded.*return"` → 6, `git stash pop`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Reproduced on clean d712168f with repairs stashed (6 occurrences); identical with repairs applied; deterministic clippy deny, not intermittent
